product.description: În cea mai recentă carte a sa, Boris Cyrulnik analizează nevoia noastră de a avea o credință. De unde vine aceasta? La ce ne ajută? Unul dintre cei mai cunoscuți psihologi ai lumii ne oferă o viziune inedită cu privire la real ția noastră cu religia. „Cyrulnik a vindecat oameni și țări.“ The Times Boris Cyrulnik, neuropsihiatru, este cel care a făcut celebru conceptul de „reziliență“, în urma experienței sale din copilărie căreia a reușit să îi supraviețuiască (a scăpat ca prin urechile acului de naziști și de deportarea în cursul căreia i-au fost uciși părinții), și a fost desemnat de Emmanuel Macron pentru a reforma sistemul educaţional din Franţa. Semnează mai multe volume de mare succes, cu peste 1,5 milioane de exemplare vândute în întreaga lume, printre care Un merveilleux Malheur (1999), Les Vilains Petits Canards (2001), Parler d’amour au bord du gouffre (2004), Sauve-toi, la vie t’appelle (2012) și Ivres paradis, bonheurs héroïques (2016).

# The Psychotherapy of God: Exploring Faith and the Human Mind

***Psihoterapia lui Dumnezeu*** **(The Psychotherapy of God)** is a profound exploration into one of humanity's most enduring questions: our need for belief. In this groundbreaking work, renowned neuropsychiatrist Boris Cyrulnik analyzes the deep connection between spirituality, faith, and mental well-being.

For those interested in the intersection of psychology, religion, and resilience, this book offers a unique perspective on what guides us and how belief systems shape our understanding of reality.

## Understanding Faith: A Psychological Perspective

In his latest major work, Boris Cyrulnik delves into the fundamental human need to believe. The author asks crucial questions: Where does this innate need for faith originate? And more importantly, how does it benefit us psychologically?

Drawing upon decades of research and clinical experience, the world-renowned psychologist provides an unprecedented view on humanity's relationship with religion. This text moves beyond simple theological discussion, offering a rigorous scientific analysis of belief systemsâa vital read for anyone seeking to understand the psychological mechanisms behind spirituality.

## About Boris Cyrulnik: A Global Authority on Resilience

Boris Cyrulnik is one of the most distinguished psychologists and neuropsychiatrists in the world. His work has significantly contributed to global understanding of trauma, recovery, and human strength. He is best known for popularizing the concept of **"resilience,"** a term derived from his own survival experienceâhaving overcome extreme childhood adversity, including escaping Nazi bullet train attempts and surviving the deportation during which his parents were killed.

His influential contributions have earned him recognition worldwide; he was even appointed by Emmanuel Macron to reform France's educational system. With over 1.5 million copies sold globally across multiple successful volumes (including *Un merveilleux Malheur* and *Sauve-toi, la vie tâappelle*), Cyrulnik remains a leading voice in psychological literature.

***

### Key Topics Covered

*   The evolutionary roots of the human need for faith.
*   How belief structures provide meaning and coping mechanisms.
*   Scientific approaches to understanding spiritual experiences.
*   The concept of resilience developed through trauma and recovery.

## Purchase Your Copy Today

Gain deeper insights into the powerful link between our inner lives and our beliefs. Get your copy of *Psihoterapia lui Dumnezeu* now:

***

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this book purely religious?**
A: No. While it addresses faith and spirituality, the approach is rooted in clinical neuropsychiatry and psychology, offering an academic analysis of belief rather than a theological treatise.

**Q: Who should read this book?**
A: Anyone interested in the intersection of mental health, spirituality, philosophy, or trauma recovery will find value in Cyrulnik's insights.
